assessment: Heuristic evidence-maturity rubric for repository loop design, not product-completion percentage or private automation audit.
aggregation: Equal-weight sum of ten ordinal dimensions; descriptive only, not probability.

dimensions.rationale: Fresh overlapping-scope claims must precede writes.
Existing Q0-Q6 preserved; component and main separate.
Explicit uncertain readback and exhausted retries tested synthetically.
Four roles have declared inputs/outputs; no executable port integration.
Event triggers and bounded cycle specified, no scheduler evidence.
Shape and conditional receipt validation only; no durable checkpoint or transition execution.
Hard gates precede ranking; no-option/unknown/tie tests.
Measurement contract exists; no comparable real observations.
One evidence-backed hypothesis/change per cycle; not exercised live.
Pure proposal layer; no observed repeated autonomous operation.

after_condition: After values apply only once the included design tests pass; independent review and CI are separately reported.
highest_value_next_steps: Implement durable checkpoint/readback seam in existing controller owner only after Level 1 acceptance.
Record one actual bounded audit-to-advance-to-independent-review cycle before operational scoring.
Measure comparable repeats before claiming efficiency gains.
